resources.string: Owner-controlled root status and recovery safety for supported SwirPhoneOS builds.
Root changes require an exact supported build, a verified device profile, rollback material, a journal, a safe update state and explicit owner confirmation. This source stage has no mutation backend.
Reviewing a workflow never changes the device. Enable and unroot stay blocked until a physically verified build-specific backend and rollback path exist.
